catalog_units_weight.name: catalog_units_weight
catalog_units_weight.value:
("catalog_units"."kind" = 'bag' and "catalog_units"."kilograms_per_unit" is null) or
    ("catalog_units"."kind" = 'fixed' and "catalog_units"."kilograms_per_unit" is not null and "catalog_units"."kilograms_per_unit" > 0
    and "catalog_units"."kilograms_per_unit" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("catalog_units"."kilograms_per_unit") <= 3)

receipt_items_quantity.name: receipt_items_quantity
receipt_items_quantity.value:
"goods_receipt_items"."quantity" > 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."quantity") <= 18
    and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_kg" > 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."quantity_kg") <= 3
    and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_measure_kg" > 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_measure_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."quantity_measure_kg") <= 3
    and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_kg" = "goods_receipt_items"."quantity" * "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_measure_kg"
    and "goods_receipt_items"."previous_quantity_kg" >= 0 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."previous_quantity_kg") <= 3
    and "goods_receipt_items"."cumulative_quantity_kg" = "goods_receipt_items"."previous_quantity_kg" + "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_kg" and "goods_receipt_items"."cumulative_quantity_kg" < 1000000000000000000

receipt_items_snapshots.name: receipt_items_snapshots
receipt_items_snapshots.value:
length(btrim("goods_receipt_items"."product_name")) between 1 and 80 and length(btrim("goods_receipt_items"."quantity_unit_name")) between 1 and 80
    and length(btrim("goods_receipt_items"."price_unit_name")) between 1 and 80 and "goods_receipt_items"."quantity_unit_kind" in ('fixed', 'bag')
    and "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."unit_price") <= 2
    and "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg" > 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg") <= 3

receipt_items_value.name: receipt_items_value
receipt_items_value.value:
"goods_receipt_items"."previously_recognized" >= 0 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."previously_recognized") <= 2
    and "goods_receipt_items"."recognized_value" >= 0 and "goods_receipt_items"."recognized_value" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("goods_receipt_items"."recognized_value") <= 2
    and "goods_receipt_items"."previously_recognized" * 100 = div("goods_receipt_items"."previous_quantity_kg" * "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" * 100, "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg")
      + case when mod("goods_receipt_items"."previous_quantity_kg" * "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" * 100, "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg") * 2 >= "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg" then 1 else 0 end
    and ("goods_receipt_items"."previously_recognized" + "goods_receipt_items"."recognized_value") * 100 = div("goods_receipt_items"."cumulative_quantity_kg" * "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" * 100, "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg")
      + case when mod("goods_receipt_items"."cumulative_quantity_kg" * "goods_receipt_items"."unit_price" * 100, "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg") * 2 >= "goods_receipt_items"."price_measure_kg" then 1 else 0 end

receipts_approval.name: receipts_approval
receipts_approval.value:
("goods_receipts"."variance_reason" is null and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_user_id" is null and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_membership_id" is null)
    or ("goods_receipts"."variance_reason" is not null and length(btrim("goods_receipts"."variance_reason")) between 1 and 500
      and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_user_id" is not null and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_user_id" = "goods_receipts"."accepted_by_user_id"
      and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_membership_id" is not null and "goods_receipts"."variance_approved_by_membership_id" = "goods_receipts"."accepted_by_membership_id")

movements_source.name: movements_source
movements_source.value:
("inventory_movements"."kind" = 'receipt' and "inventory_movements"."receipt_item_id" is not null and "inventory_movements"."quantity_kg" > 0
    and "inventory_movements"."request_id" is null and "inventory_movements"."request_fingerprint" is null and "inventory_movements"."reason_code" is null and "inventory_movements"."reason" is null
    and "inventory_movements"."reference" is null and "inventory_movements"."product_name" is null and "inventory_movements"."warehouse_name" is null)
    or ("inventory_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "inventory_movements"."receipt_item_id" is null and "inventory_movements"."request_id" is not null
    and "inventory_movements"."request_fingerprint" is not null and "inventory_movements"."request_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and "inventory_movements"."reason_code" is not null and "inventory_movements"."reason_code" in ('loss', 'spoilage', 'count_correction', 'opening_stock')
    and "inventory_movements"."reason" is not null and length(btrim("inventory_movements"."reason")) between 1 and 500
    and "inventory_movements"."reference" is not null and length("inventory_movements"."reference") <= 100
    and "inventory_movements"."product_name" is not null and length(btrim("inventory_movements"."product_name")) > 0
    and "inventory_movements"."warehouse_name" is not null and length(btrim("inventory_movements"."warehouse_name")) > 0
    and ("inventory_movements"."reason_code" = 'count_correction' or ("inventory_movements"."reason_code" = 'opening_stock' and "inventory_movements"."quantity_kg" > 0)
      or ("inventory_movements"."reason_code" in ('loss', 'spoilage') and "inventory_movements"."quantity_kg" < 0)))

products_sku.name: products_sku
products_sku.value: "products"."sku" is null or ("products"."sku" = btrim("products"."sku") and length("products"."sku") between 1 and 40)

purchase_items_received.name: purchase_items_received
purchase_items_received.value:
"purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg" >= 0 and "purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg") <= 3
    and "purchase_order_items"."approved_extra_kg" >= 0 and "purchase_order_items"."approved_extra_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."approved_extra_kg") <= 3
    and "purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg" <= "purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" + "purchase_order_items"."approved_extra_kg"
    and "purchase_order_items"."recognized_value" >= 0 and "purchase_order_items"."recognized_value" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."recognized_value") <= 2
    and "purchase_order_items"."recognized_value" * 100 = div("purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg" * "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" * 100, "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg")
      + case when mod("purchase_order_items"."received_quantity_kg" * "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" * 100, "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg") * 2 >= "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg" then 1 else 0 end

purchase_items_names.name: purchase_items_names
purchase_items_names.value: length(btrim("purchase_order_items"."product_name")) between 1 and 80 and length(btrim("purchase_order_items"."quantity_unit_name")) between 1 and 80 and length(btrim("purchase_order_items"."price_unit_name")) between 1 and 80

purchase_items_quantity.name: purchase_items_quantity
purchase_items_quantity.value:
"purchase_order_items"."quantity" > 0 and "purchase_order_items"."quantity" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."quantity") <= 18
    and "purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" > 0 and "purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg") <= 3
    and "purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" = "purchase_order_items"."quantity" * "purchase_order_items"."quantity_measure_kg"

purchase_items_money.name: purchase_items_money
purchase_items_money.value:
"purchase_order_items"."unit_price" >= 0 and "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."unit_price") <= 2
    and "purchase_order_items"."line_total" >= 0 and "purchase_order_items"."line_total" < 1000000000000000000 and scale("purchase_order_items"."line_total") <= 2
    and "purchase_order_items"."line_total" * 100 = div("purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" * "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" * 100, "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg")
      + case when mod("purchase_order_items"."quantity_kg" * "purchase_order_items"."unit_price" * 100, "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg") * 2 >= "purchase_order_items"."price_measure_kg" then 1 else 0 end

purchase_orders_revision.name: purchase_orders_revision
purchase_orders_revision.value:
"purchase_orders"."revision" >= 1 and (
    ("purchase_orders"."revision" = 1 and "purchase_orders"."last_mutation_id" is null and "purchase_orders"."last_mutation_fingerprint" is null)
    or ("purchase_orders"."revision" > 1 and "purchase_orders"."last_mutation_id" is not null and "purchase_orders"."last_mutation_fingerprint" is not null
      and "purchase_orders"."last_mutation_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "purchase_orders"."updated_by_user_id" is not null
      and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."updated_by_user_id")) > 0 and "purchase_orders"."updated_by_membership_id" is not null and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."updated_by_membership_id")) > 0))

purchase_orders_ordering.name: purchase_orders_ordering
purchase_orders_ordering.value:
(
    ("purchase_orders"."ordered_at" is null and "purchase_orders"."ordered_by_user_id" is null and "purchase_orders"."ordered_by_membership_id" is null and "purchase_orders"."status" not in ('ordered', 'partially_received', 'received'))
    or ("purchase_orders"."ordered_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."ordered_by_user_id" is not null and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."ordered_by_user_id")) > 0
      and "purchase_orders"."ordered_by_membership_id" is not null and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."ordered_by_membership_id")) > 0 and "purchase_orders"."status" <> 'draft'))

purchase_orders_cancellation.name: purchase_orders_cancellation
purchase_orders_cancellation.value:
(
    ("purchase_orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is null and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_membership_id" is null and "purchase_orders"."cancellation_reason" is null)
    or ("purchase_orders"."status" = 'cancelled' and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null
      and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_user_id")) > 0 and "purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_membership_id" is not null
      and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."cancelled_by_membership_id")) > 0 and "purchase_orders"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(btrim("purchase_orders"."cancellation_reason")) between 1 and 500))

suppliers_phone.name: suppliers_phone
suppliers_phone.value:
"suppliers"."phone" is null or ("suppliers"."phone" = btrim("suppliers"."phone") and length("suppliers"."phone") between 3 and 40
    and "suppliers"."phone" ~ '^[+0-9۰-۹٠-٩(). -]+$' and "suppliers"."phone" ~ '[0-9۰-۹٠-٩]')

suppliers_location.name: suppliers_location
suppliers_location.value: "suppliers"."location" is null or ("suppliers"."location" = btrim("suppliers"."location") and length("suppliers"."location") between 1 and 200)

suppliers_notes.name: suppliers_notes
suppliers_notes.value: "suppliers"."notes" is null or ("suppliers"."notes" = btrim("suppliers"."notes") and length("suppliers"."notes") between 1 and 2000)

suppliers_payment_terms.name: suppliers_payment_terms
suppliers_payment_terms.value: "suppliers"."payment_terms" is null or ("suppliers"."payment_terms" = btrim("suppliers"."payment_terms") and length("suppliers"."payment_terms") between 1 and 500)

warehouses_location.name: warehouses_location
warehouses_location.value: "warehouses"."location" is null or ("warehouses"."location" = btrim("warehouses"."location") and length("warehouses"."location") between 1 and 200)
